info.title: trovster.com
info.description: This documentation provides the information needed to work with the trovster.com API and its data.

get.description:
This endpoint allows you to list all activities. Each entry contains basic activity information, such as title, date, summary, speed, distance, moving time and type. The summary is a useful sentence describing the activity.
The results are paginated.

path.description: Base path for paginator generated URLs.

per_page.description: Number of items shown per page.

to.description: Number of the last item in the slice.

total.description: Total number of items being paginated.

get.description:
This endpoint allows you to get a specific activity, based on the Strava ID. The entry contains the same information provided in the listing, but also includes any extra text and the polyline representation. The type is an object which includes the ID as well as the type name. The summary is a useful sentence describing the activity.
The polyline can be used with mapping software to show the route.

This endpoint allows you to import raw Health Auto Export JSON data.
The JSON is archived as a file using the unique session ID, then parsed
in the background to store health metrics and sleep.

get.description:
This endpoint allows you to list all the fitness data. Each entry contains basic fitness information, such as date, summary, steps, distance and flights. There are objects for move, exercise and stand data. These include the total, goal, percent and whether the item was completed. The summary is a useful sentence describing the information.
The results are paginated.

post.description:
This endpoint allows you to store fitness data.
It requires a date and basic health data, such as active energy, step count,
distance and flights climbed. The totals for move, exercise and stand are also
required.

This endpoint shows statistics for a specific year.
The result is broken down into content areas: movies, activities,
music, photos and blog. Each area includes a count and time where appropriate.
Movies and photos show top items and music includes top artists and tracks.
Activities include cycled and walked statistics and detailed information on the
longest activity in each.
<aside class="notice">View results at https://stats.trovster.com</aside>
This endpoint shows the years which statistics are available for.
